What is the Waterfall methodology?"
column8:
Linear, sequential made up of:
Analysis, Design, Implementation, Testing, Maintenance
Whole stage must be completed before moving to next.

What is the Extreme Programming methodology?"
column9:
Follows agile paradigm, focus on high quality code and rapid development through paired programming, continuous testing, frequent releases and refactoring.\n+ High code quality, bug identified early, adaptable, feedback\n- Requires high dev+client commitment, less documentation, not ideal for large teams.
What is Agile methodology?"
column10:
Iterative, frequent client feedback in small increments.
Prioritises working software over documents, can handle changing requirements.
+ Flexible, regular feedback, issues identified early
- Less documentation, hard to manage
What is the Spiral methodology?"
column11:
Iterative progressing through repeated loops.
Set objectives, Analyse risks, Develop and test, Client review.
Prototypes in each iteration.
+ Risk management, problems identified early, freq client feedback, suitable for complex systems
- Complex to manage, expensive and time consuming
For high risk and uncertain projects.
What is the Rapid Application Development methodology?"
column12:
Focuses on rapid prototyping, little formal analysis or design with prototypes continuously refined using user feedback.\n+ Very fast, early working models, flexible\n- Less documentation, poor design if rushed, not for safety critical systems.
